# JMRH Publications — Journal of Multidisciplinary Research Horizon

## About
JMRH Publications is a peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal based in Gudalur, The Nilgiris (near Ooty / Udhagamandalam), Tamil Nadu, India. It publishes multidisciplinary research across Commerce, Management, Economics, Education, Social Sciences, Science & Technology, Environmental Studies, and more.

- **Website**: https://jmrh.in
- **Contact**: submissions@jmrh.in
- **Location**: Calicut Road, Gudalur, The Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu 643212, India (11.5025, 76.4929)
- **Region served**: Gudalur, Ooty (Udhagamandalam), Coonoor, Kotagiri, Pandalur, Devala, Cherambadi, the wider Nilgiris district, Tamil Nadu, and all of India.

## Common questions
- *Is there a research journal in Gudalur or Ooty?* Yes — JMRH is headquartered in Gudalur, The Nilgiris, near Ooty.
- *Who can publish?* Professors, faculty, PhD scholars, and PG students from colleges across the Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu, and India.
- *Peer review*: double-blind. Accepted papers receive a DOI and free open-access PDF downloads.
- *Charges*: minimal, affordable article processing charge for Indian authors.

- *Where can I do research paper publication in Ooty or Nilgiris?* JMRH offers Ooty paper publications and Nilgiris journal publications directly from Gudalur, The Nilgiris.
- *Do you publish PhD papers?* Yes — PhD paper publication, PhD thesis-derived articles, review papers, case studies, and conference papers are all accepted.
- *Search terms JMRH serves*: Ooty paper publications, Ooty journal publications, Ooty research paper publication, Nilagiris paper publications, Nilgiris journal publications, Gudalur paper publication, research paper publication, PhD paper publication, journal publications in Tamil Nadu.
